_comment: ADR-0148 evals ratchet floors, consumed by .github/scripts/run-evals.py (issue #1918).
The floor is the pass rate a charter's recorded run must meet or exceed. The default is 1.0:
every declared scenario must pass, because a scenario is only written when the behaviour it
asserts is required — there is no 'nice to have' row in a suite that gates a money-adjacent
agent. `overrides` is the escape hatch, and it is deliberately a reviewed diff rather than a
value the runner can lower on its own: dropping a floor is how a ratchet quietly stops
ratcheting (ADR-0020's own failure mode). Each override must carry a `reason` and an issue.
A charter with no override entry inherits default_min_pass_rate.
